title: Split Flap
description: A Beatles setlist on a departure board, built flap by flap. Click a track to put it on and every changed letter rolls through the drum to its new place; drag a row to reorder, or type to rename one.
intent: One clean physical mechanism finished to the edge: every character is a pair of real flaps on a hinge, and the ripple comes from each cell stepping through its drum in order.
